title: App works in the browser, targets are unhealthy
briefing: After enabling HTTPS hardening, the site loads fine for users but the load balancer targets become unhealthy.

artifacts.logs: ALB target health checks are failing with HTTP 301 redirects.

options.text: Make the health endpoint exempt from the HTTPS redirect

options.why_wrong: This removes a real protection. The goal is to keep HTTPS and make the health check work.

options.text: Add more instances behind the load balancer
options.why_wrong: Every instance fails the same health check.
This is a configuration issue, not a stuck process.

explanation: The health check uses plain HTTP and expects 200. With SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT enabled, Django redirects it to HTTPS and returns 301.
lesson: Redirects count as health-check failures. Keep the health endpoint reachable over plain HTTP.
hints: What status code does the health check actually get?
Which Django setting redirects HTTP requests to HTTPS?
